title: 第九章 神魔体第十章 家族的希望
lines: “来吧！”孟川看着台下，眼神炽热。
吴琦听到院长的命令有些错愕，但跟着眼睛渐渐亮了起来，看着擂台上的孟川，咧嘴一笑：“好，那就打上一场。”
嗖。
他一迈步就到了擂台上，比之前的白贯要快得多。
“锵。”他将背着的盾牌拿在手中，又从盾牌内拔出了一柄厚背大砍刀，这大砍刀通体黑色，微微泛着红光。
一手盾，一手持着厚背大砍刀，吴琦站在那，仿佛一座不可撼动的高山，有无形气息释放开来，让远处围观的众多师弟师妹们都不由心颤。
“吴琦师兄修炼的神魔体，是暗云魔体吧。”孟川说道，那让他都有些心惊的气息显然就是神魔体的气息。
“不错，正是暗云魔体！”吴琦说完后便陡然冲向孟川，一人冲击，却仿佛大军压来！没有什么变招，是纯粹的速度力量冲击。
吴琦持着盾牌冲到近前，快如幻影，直接一盾牌撞击向孟川，这威势就是一座房屋都能撞塌了。
只是孟川脚下一动，就避开了盾牌这一击到了吴琦的侧方，刀光一闪就已经劈向吴琦。
“杀。”吴琦在盾牌落空的刹那，非常熟练的挥出厚背大砍刀，和孟川那一刀撞击在一起。
两柄刀撞击在一起，溅起火花。
吴琦后退了一步便稳住身形，孟川则是脚下一点往后飞了数丈。
“施展秘技，竟然能爆发这么强的力量？”吴琦瞳孔一缩。
凡俗修炼：筑基、内炼、洗髓、脱胎、无漏。
其中前三重的修炼都还算普通，能修炼出真气，且令凡俗肉身逐渐强大，彼此差距并不太大。
可第四重‘脱胎’的含义，是脱去凡胎！因为这一重就开始修炼神魔体，让凡人开始拥有部分神魔的力量，这提升幅度就有些惊人了。吴琦修炼的是暗云魔体，且达到脱胎境圆满。他的力量速度非常恐怖惊人，远远超越洗髓境圆满。
如果对付正常的洗髓境，若是双刀对砍，他一刀就能砍死洗髓境。
就算洗髓境持着盾牌，也会被一刀震得吐血。
实在是力量相差太大！
“他刚才爆发的力量，接近我的七成，这都相当于我脱胎境后期时的力量了。”吴琦很吃惊，“这就是秘技的威力吗？”
他早知道秘技的恐怖。
甚至这一战，他赢面都很小。
“我还是有望赢的。”吴琦一咬牙再度冲上，他蛮横的犹如骑兵，迅猛冲撞。
“我借助秘技爆发的力量还是比他小些，三秋叶，终究是倾向于速度的秘技。”孟川暗道，身形一动在十余丈外就出现了另一个‘孟川’。
“在这边！”吴琦修炼暗云魔体，擅长感应周围，能够感应到一道身影已经杀到。
相比于白贯毫无还手之力。
吴琦，连秘技‘三秋叶’最擅长的速度都能感应，且能做出应对。
“轰。”他的厚背大砍刀，一刀就劈过去。
他一刀劈了个空，可他手中的盾却挡住了孟川神出鬼没的一刀。
“真快，我还是劈空了。”吴琦心中发紧，幸好他谨慎下盾牌护住周围，一手盾一手大砍刀，施展的正是镜湖道院的一门绝学《两仪盾刀术》，这门顶尖绝学在战场上活下来的希望非常大。所以吴琦选择了适合这门绝学的暗云魔体。
暗云魔体，配合两仪盾刀术。
防守起来滴水不漏，攻击也凶猛，他也仗此名列镜湖道院脱胎境弟子第一。
“两仪盾刀术，一阴，一阳，的确厉害。不过，不知道能挡住我几招。”孟川声音还在响着，就扑杀过来。
“没用的，你伤不了我。”吴琦站在那，刀盾配合又挡住了孟川飘忽的一刀。
孟川身法极快，一道又一道的刀光，施展的正是落叶刀法。
content_en:
"Come on!" Meng Chuan looked at the audience with fiery eyes.
Wu Qi was a little startled when he heard the dean's order, but his eyes gradually brightened up. He looked at Meng Chuan on the ring and grinned: "Okay, let's have a fight."
Whoosh.
He reached the ring in one step, much faster than Bai Guan before.
"Qiang." He took the shield on his back in his hand, and pulled out a thick-backed machete from the shield. The machete was completely black with a slight red light.
With a shield in one hand and a thick-backed machete in the other, Wu Qi stood there like an unshakable mountain. An invisible aura was released, making the many junior brothers and sisters watching from a distance tremble.
"The God-Demon Body that Senior Brother Wu Qi cultivated must be the Dark Cloud Demon Body." Meng Chuan said. The aura that frightened him was obviously that of the God-Demon Body.
"Yes, it's the Dark Cloud Demonic Body!" After Wu Qi finished speaking, he suddenly rushed towards Meng Chuan. He attacked alone, but it seemed like an army was pressing down on him! There are no tricks, it's pure speed and power.
"Boom."
Wu Qi rushed forward with a shield, as fast as a phantom, and directly hit Meng Chuan with the shield. This power was so powerful that it could collapse a house.
Just by moving his feet, Meng Chuan avoided the shield and hit Wu Qi's side. The sword flashed and struck Wu Qi.
"Kill." When the shield fell, Wu Qi skillfully swung the thick-backed machete and collided with Meng Chuan's knife.
Bang——
The two knives collided together, causing sparks to fly.
Wu Qi took a step back and stabilized his figure, while Meng Chuan flew back a few feet.
"Using secret skills, you can actually explode such a strong force?" Wu Qi's pupils shrank.
Ordinary cultivation: foundation building, internal refining, marrow cleansing, rebirth, and no leakage.
Among them, the first three levels of cultivation are relatively ordinary. They can cultivate true energy and make the mortal body gradually stronger. The gap between them is not too big.
But the fourth level of ‘reborn’ means getting rid of the mortal body! Because this level begins to cultivate the body of gods and demons, allowing mortals to begin to possess some of the powers of gods and demons, this improvement is somewhat astonishing. Wu Qi cultivated the dark cloud demon body and reached the perfection of rebirth. The speed of his power is terrifying and astonishing, far beyond the perfection of the Marrow Cleansing Realm.
If he were to deal with a normal Marrow Cleansing Realm, and if he slashed with two swords, he could kill the Marrow Cleansing Realm with one slash.
Even if you are holding a shield in the Marrow Cleansing Realm, you will be shocked by the knife and vomit blood.
There is really a huge difference in power!
"The power he just exploded is close to 70% of mine, which is equivalent to the power I had when I was in the late stage of Rebirth Realm." Wu Qi was surprised, "Is this the power of the secret technique?"
He already knew the horror of the secret technique.
Even in this battle, his chances of winning were very small.
"I still hope to win." Wu Qi gritted his teeth and charged forward again. He was as arrogant as a cavalry, charging quickly.
"The power I can explode with the help of secret skills is still smaller than him. Sanqiuye, after all, is a secret skill that favors speed." Meng Chuan secretly thought, and as soon as his body moved, another 'Meng Chuan' appeared more than ten feet away.
"Over here!" Wu Qi cultivated the Dark Cloud Demon Body and was good at sensing the surroundings. He could sense that a figure was approaching.
Compared to Bai Guan, he has no power to fight back.
Wu Qi can even sense the speed of the secret skill 'Three Autumn Leaves', which he is good at, and can respond to it.
"Boom." His thick-backed machete slashed through with one blow.
"Cang!!!"
He struck the air with one strike, but the shield in his hand blocked Meng Chuan's elusive strike.
"It's so fast, I still hit the air." Wu Qi's heart tightened. Fortunately, he carefully used his shield to protect his surroundings. He used a shield in one hand and a machete in the other. What he used was the "Liangyi Shield Sword Technique", a secret skill of Jinghu Taoist Academy. This top secret skill has a high chance of surviving on the battlefield. So Wu Qi chose the dark cloud demon body that was suitable for this unique skill.
Dark cloud demon body, combined with Liangyi shield sword technique.
His defense is watertight and his attacks are ferocious. He is also ranked number one among Jinghu Taoist Temple's Reborn Realm disciples.
"The Liangyi Shield Sword Technique, one yin and one yang, is indeed powerful. However, I don't know how many of my moves can be blocked." Meng Chuan's voice was still ringing, and he rushed over.
"It's useless, you can't hurt me." Wu Qi stood there, using his sword and shield to block Meng Chuan's erratic knife.
"Pfft."
"Pfft."
"Phew."
Meng Chuan's movements were extremely fast, and the sword rays were fired one after another, using the Falling Leaf Sword Technique.
title_en: Chapter 9 The Body of God and Demon Chapter 10 The Hope of the Family
